description: For a connected Port66 account: whose account it is and what this assistant may do for them. Returns the scopes the user granted (browse, offer, buy), max_order_usd (the most one purchase or offer may be), daily_limit_usd and remaining_today_usd. Check it before start_purchase or make_offer and ask the user before anything above these limits; Port66 refuses it anyway. Requires a connected account.
name: account_limits
title: Account limits
